observations: Photo 0 shows a vintage-style black sewing machine head mounted on a wooden table/cabinet.
Machine body has gold floral/scroll decorative painting typical of old manual sewing machines.
A hand-crank wheel is visible on the right side, suggesting manual (non-electric) operation.
Gold lettering is present on the machine body but is stylized and partially obscured by glare; not clearly legible.
A watermark 'MAY LENAPHEAL' overlays the lower part of the image, not part of the item.
No power cord, foot pedal, or plug is visible, consistent with a manual/treadle-style machine.
No close-up of stitching, bobbin area, or serial plate is provided.
Wooden table shows visible wear, staining, and age on its surface.

identity.kind: manual hand-crank sewing machine with wooden table

claims.claim: Durable, highly reliable sewing machine for fashion business or home use
claims.evidence: No functional demonstration (stitching, running motion) shown in the single photo; this is seller marketing language.

risks.risk: Machine may not sew properly or crank mechanism may be seized/damaged
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the hand crank turning smoothly and producing a test stitch on fabric

risks.risk: Missing or damaged internal parts (bobbin case, needle, tension assembly)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the bobbin area and needle plate with components in place

risks.risk: Brand/model cannot be confirmed, which affects value and parts availability
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the gold nameplate/lettering on the machine head
risks.if_unproven: priced as unbranded generic manual machine

risks.risk: Wooden table/cabinet may have structural damage (cracks, instability) not visible from this angle
risks.proof: Photos of the table from multiple angles including underside and legs
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming cosmetic wear only, no structural guarantee

risks.risk: Rust or corrosion on metal parts hidden by paint/decoration
risks.proof: Close-up photos of hinges, wheel axle, and underside metal parts
risks.if_unproven: priced as having possible hidden rust

proof_requests: Close-up, well-lit photo of the brand nameplate/lettering on the machine head
Short video of the hand crank turning and the needle moving, ideally stitching a scrap of fabric
Photo of the underside of the machine and the full table/cabinet including legs
Photo of the bobbin case, needle, and tension discs
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a manual hand-crank sewing machine on a wooden table by type, but no functional proof or legible brand/model is shown, so it must be priced at worst case as an unbranded, unverified-working unit pending further proof.
